question_en: Which actors have played the character of Tom Ripley in films?
question_fr: Quels acteurs ont incarné le personnage de Tom Ripley dans des films ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.ID_PERSON FROM T_WC_T2S_PERSON p JOIN T_WC_T2S_PERSON_MOVIE pm ON pm.ID_PERSON = p.ID_PERSON WHERE pm.CAST_CHARACTER = 'Tom Ripley' AND pm.CREDIT_TYPE = 'cast' AND pm.CAST_CHARACTER NOT IN ('Self', 'Himself', 'Herself', '(archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage)', 'Self (archive footage) (uncredited)', 'Self (uncredited)', 'Self (archive footage) (uncredited)') ORDER BY pm.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC LIMIT 5
